description: Defines classes for wrapping and iterating over ProcessedNode inputs and outputs in PyTorch JIT runtime, facilitating code reuse and performance optimizations.

classes.name: ProcessedNodeWrapperBase
classes.description: Base template class providing iterator support for ProcessedNode wrappers.

classes.name: ProcessedNodeInputWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ProcessedNode inputs, allowing access to tensors with optional ignored elements.

classes.name: ProcessedNodeOutputWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for ProcessedNode outputs, allowing access and modification of tensors.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of the wrapper.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the wrapper.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements (inputs or outputs).
